ownershipColorCheck.method: native-input-smoke with a script sampling the fixture window's page-frame border and selected-tab border about every 130 ms.
ownershipColorCheck.result: Frame and tab matched in every settled state through the click and typing pauses; differing samples occurred only mid-fade, within the 240 ms transition. Samples while Controls covered the shell during the dialog were not used.

earlierCandidate.note: startup-integration (7/7, Computer Use Menu > Exit) ran only on this pre-fix CI DLL; it was not repeated on the release DLL. Shell tabs (8/8) and native input with dialog (3/3) also passed on it before being repeated on the release DLL.

preparationHistory.result: integration 14/17: stale_element after a static ready marker; fixed in #10 (DOMContentLoaded) and #11 (load event and read-only page_changed retry).

preparationHistory.step: First push run with hosted live suites
preparationHistory.result: integration and upload-entry failed with page_changed before #11; the next main run passed.

ui-language and introduction failed 7 of 10 runs at varying steps by reading windows before setup finished; the 0.1.1 DLL failed the tour modal check in 2 of 3 runs. #12 made the checks wait; 10/10 runs then passed.

Reported during hands-on testing. The tab tree was not repainted during the accent fade: frame orange/tab teal for 1.8 s after a click, frame teal/tab orange for 7.5 s after the pause ended, frame gray/tab orange until close. Fixed in #13 and rechecked on the release DLL.
1 check passed, then the harness failed with EPERM renaming native-autofill-request.tmp over native-autofill-request.json in the fixture profile. The immediate rerun passed 11/11.

cefMaintenance: Dependency pins unchanged. CEF 154.0.34+g14c5a08 (Chromium 154.0.8037.98) was the newest stable Windows x64 entry in the CEF build index checked October 6.
limits: Computer Use input is OS-level synthesized mouse and keyboard input, not a person at the device.
High contrast, non-100% DPI, Light theme for the ownership-color check, real sites and real accounts were not exercised.
Startup was not repeated on the release DLL; the only native change after that run is the shell repaint fix.
The AuthTest fixture is a local build of the same native sources and is never shipped.
Downloads are unsigned; hashes establish byte integrity, not publisher identity.
privacy: Disposable synthetic profiles and fixtures only. The user's installed browser and profile were not tested, modified or replaced; no tokens, raw calls, browsing logs, vault data or screenshots are recorded.
